snippet.text:
noncomputable def rational (u q : ℤ) : Build Poly := fun s =>
  let k := normalize u q
  if k.2 = 1 then (C k.1, s) else
    match s.globals.find? (fun e => e.2 == k) with
    | some e => (X e.1, s)
    | none => (X s.next, ⟨s.next + 1, s.globals ++ [(s.next, k)]⟩)
